scope: Shared data only; model, simulator, NLQ/RAG and UI implementations are separate branches
cutoff_policy: Do not mix artifact cutoffs; June outcomes locked until separate model release workflow
operational_estimate_status: Candidate; retained in feature/daily internal artifacts, not silently approved for serving

module_1.aggregation: Sum numerator/denominator components; select one period/metric/audit scope; Unknown is not zero

output_requirements: one selected run, no fabricated missing outputs
module_2.unreleased_behavior: Empty typed output tables and Unavailable_model_not_released, never zero risk
module_2.aggregate_access: Aggregated counts/metrics only; manager-only with full-population scope, enforced by ServingReader.read and read_page
module_2.output_publisher: data_platform.model_outputs.build_serving_with_model_outputs: new immutable serving artifact from a verified base; isolated candidate roots only
module_2.paged_read: ServingReader.read_page(name, principal_id, *, start, end, store_id, sku_id, after, page_size<=1000); fixed view allowlist and keyset order; cursor bound to artifact/view/filters/principal/scope
module_2.test_release: oos_test_release.v2 via data_platform.test_release.authorize_rolling_test_release with the project exposure ledger (data_platform.test_exposure); plan-bound test labels only via build-labels --purpose test

module_3.policy: Requires review until guardrail units/composition/version approved; source flag is historical evidence, not platform approval
module_3.price_cost_basis: Static reference product dimensions and reported invoices; currency not supplied

module_4.nlq_runtime: Must enforce SELECT/function/view allowlists, verified identity scope and limits; never expose a raw DuckDB connection to an LLM

knowledge_contract.corpus_status: Not supplied by the eight CSVs; ingestion/retrieval belongs to Module 4

postgres_serving.status: Opt-in; verified against a local disposable PostgreSQL with synthetic data; no shared deployment or module cutover implied
postgres_serving.publisher: python -m data_platform.postgres_cli (inspect-source, preflight, init, load, validate, activate, rollback, configure-scopes); inspect-source/preflight read-only; init/load/activate/rollback/configure-scopes dry run unless --apply --confirm-database; validate records its result and on failure marks the release Failed and withdraws reader access
postgres_serving.reader: data_platform.readers.open_business_reader(backend='postgres', postgres_config=...) -> same read/read_page/principal_scope/schema API, limits and errors as ServingReader; pins one published release
postgres_serving.access: Scopes live in platform_access and are configured separately; application login is a member of platform_serving_reader only (SELECT on published views)
postgres_serving.integrity: Release identity binds the source run record, quality report and database bytes; payloads are write-guarded and fully re-verified before activation/rollback; a failed verification marks the release Failed and withdraws reader access; at most max_retained_releases payloads are stored in any state

access.authentication_owner: Application; principal_id must come from verified session, not query text
access.default: Deny all when assignment is absent; manager access is explicit, not automatic
access.file_access: Serving file is private to trusted application service; schemas are not security boundaries
